summary: Limits the DNS KEY resource record to keys used by DNSSEC. The original KEY record could store both DNSSEC and arbitrary application keys, which was a mistake, so this redefines the protocol octet field and removes application keys from it. It was replaced by RFC 4033, RFC 4034 and RFC 4035.

eli5.summary: DNS had one drawer for all kinds of keys. This note says that drawer is only for the DNS security system, and other keys go elsewhere. It was later replaced by RFC 4033, RFC 4034 and RFC 4035.

questions: why was dns key rr limited
